name: dauntless-assault-exalted-needs-another-advanced-element
notes: Dauntless Assault (ixIY36Ck37, EXALTED/NORM): "(Exalted -- This element is enabled for you as long as you have another advanced element enabled.)" The champion is the plain Spirit of Water (no advanced element in the lineage): activating Dauntless Assault from hand does nothing -- no payment is requested and the card stays in hand.

rulesClauses: Exalted: this element is enabled only as long as you have another advanced element enabled.
